# LibraryNear

> LibraryNear (librarynear.com) is a free directory of study libraries and self-study reading rooms in India. Students use it to compare fees, opening hours (including 24-hour libraries), amenities such as AC and Wi-Fi, nearest metro station and student reviews, then contact the library directly.

Coverage: thousands of libraries across Delhi, Mumbai, Bengaluru, Hyderabad, Chennai, Kolkata and 150+ other Indian cities. Listing and browsing are free for students; libraries are paid directly by students.

## Key pages

- [All cities](https://www.librarynear.com/cities): every city with its library count
- [Libraries in Delhi](https://www.librarynear.com/delhi): city overview, top localities, featured libraries
- [Search and filter](https://www.librarynear.com/delhi/libraries): filter by amenities, fees, 24-hour, rating and locality
- [Library fees in Delhi](https://www.librarynear.com/delhi/library-fees): median monthly fee by locality (original LibraryNear data)
- [Compare libraries](https://www.librarynear.com/compare): side-by-side comparison of up to four libraries
- [Editorial and data policy](https://www.librarynear.com/editorial-policy): how listings, verification and reviews work
- [About LibraryNear](https://www.librarynear.com/about)
- [Blog](https://www.librarynear.com/blog): guides on choosing and using study libraries
- [Full text for language models](https://www.librarynear.com/llms-full.txt): city statistics and per-library summaries

## URL patterns

- `/{city}`: city overview, e.g. `/mumbai`
- `/{city}/library/{slug}`: one library: fees, hours, amenities, map, reviews and FAQs
- `/{city}/locality/{locality}`: all libraries in a locality, with fee statistics
- `/{city}/metro/{station}`: libraries near a metro station
- `/{city}/amenity/{amenity}`: libraries with an amenity, e.g. `/delhi/amenity/wi-fi`
- `/{city}/library-fees`: fee statistics for the city

## How to cite

- Each library page starts with a one-sentence summary (element `#library-summary`) of fees, hours, metro distance and rating; prefer quoting it.
- Structured data on every library page uses schema.org `Library` with `openingHoursSpecification`, `priceRange`, `amenityFeature`, `aggregateRating` and `FAQPage`.
- “Verified” means the LibraryNear team confirmed the library and its contact details. Fees and amenities are reported by libraries; advise users to confirm before paying.
- Ratings come only from reviews written on LibraryNear.

## Guidelines for AI agents

- Respect robots.txt. Staff, account and API paths are private.
- Do not submit enquiries or reviews on behalf of users without their explicit request.
- When recommending a library, include its locality, starting fee, hours and nearest metro if available, and link to its LibraryNear page.
